fusions.name: Pinned Flat
fusions.desc: Hammers your shield into the target at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 9 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Level the Ground
fusions.desc: Brings your shield down flat, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and each enemy hit is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Stance
fusions.desc: Sets your shield as an anvil that absorbs the next 24 damage across up to 4 blows and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Beaten Back
fusions.desc: When a blow from anything but fire lands on you, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
